name: Slender West Lake
note: Scenic lake and park northwest of the old city, with pavilions, the Five-Pavilion Bridge and gardens around it.

name: Daming Temple
note: Buddhist temple on the Slender West Lake grounds, rebuilt after the Taiping Rebellion, with a spring and a tea house.

name: Geyuan Garden
note: Classical garden famed for its bamboo and rockeries that represent the four seasons.

name: He Garden
note: Classical scholar garden with tea houses, open grottoes and pleasant views, one of Jiangsu's best gardens.

name: Xu Garden, Yangzhou
note: Classical garden inside the Slender West Lake park area.

name: Yechun Garden
note: Classical garden in Yangzhou listed in the city's tourism section alongside Ge and He gardens.

name: Tomb of Puhaddin
note: Ming-era Islamic tomb complex and park of a 13th-century missionary, with a small exhibit on the Hui community.

name: Yangzhou Museum
note: City museum in the "Double Museum" building with a salvaged Grand Canal boat and Tang dragon boat on display.

name: China Grand Canal Museum
note: Museum on the Grand Canal dedicated to the canal's history and boats, free to enter.

name: Shi Kefa Memorial
note: Memorial hall and temple to a Ming general who refused to surrender Yangzhou to the Qing in 1645.

name: Tianning Temple
note: Large Buddhist temple with multiple halls, courtyards, a copy of the Siku Quanshu and a Buddhist culture exhibit.

name: Wenchang Pavilion
note: Three-storey Ming pavilion at a roundabout that marks the symbolic centre of Yangzhou, one of the few surviving old buildings.

name: Stone Pagoda, Yangzhou
note: Five-storey Tang-era stone pagoda, first built in 837, said to be the oldest pagoda still standing in Yangzhou.

name: Flat Hills Hall
note: Hall in the Slender West Lake area named in the city's tourism list (Pingshan Tang).

name: Five-Pavilion Bridge
note: Covered bridge with five terraces at the midpoint of Slender West Lake, a standard photo stop in the park.

name: Lianxing Temple White Dagoba
note: White dagoba of Lianxing Temple beside Slender West Lake, copied from a tower in Beijing's Beihai Park.

name: Fishing Platform (Diaoyutai)
note: Lakeside fishing platform in Slender West Lake park, a retreat of the Qianlong emperor per local accounts.

name: Small Gold Mountain
note: Small hill inside the Slender West Lake park area, one of the named features of the lake.

name: Lu Family Salt Merchant Residence
note: Lavishly furnished 100-room mansion of a Qing-era salt merchant, open to visitors daily.

name: Wang Residence
note: Old residence in Yangzhou's moated town named in the city's tourism overview.

name: Dongguan Street
coordinates_source: osm:attraction 东关古渡 (on Dongguan Street)
note: Old street and historic lanes east of the centre, with the Wudangxing Taoist palace and shops.

name: Xiaoqinhuai Canal
note: Canal walk that crosses the historic centre, with narrow lanes of the surviving old-city blocks nearby.

name: Songjiacheng Sports and Recreation Park
note: Gated sports park on an island east of Slender West Lake, with boardwalks through marsh, gate towers and a 3.2 km bicycle trail.

name: Baozhang Lake
note: Lake north of downtown with a boardwalk trail, popular with locals for summer swimming.

name: Zhuyuwan Scenic Area and Yangzhou Zoo
note: Scenic area and zoo about 5 km northeast of downtown.

name: Marco Polo Memorial Hall
note: Small exhibition hall on Marco Polo's journey, which Wikivoyage says is aimed at children rather than academic visitors.

name: Hongyuan Market
note: Craft and antiques market just north of the city centre.

name: Old Grand Canal, Yangzhou
coordinates_source: osm:Dongguan ancient ferry 东关古渡 (old canal)
note: Old Grand Canal route along the southern and eastern edge of the historic centre, reached by unpaved trails.

name: Han Guangling King Museum
wiki: Museum of the Han Guangling King
note: Museum at the five-storey tomb of Liu Xu, ruler of the Guangling Kingdom, with its warehouse and coffin on wheels.

name: Yangzhou Chinese Engraving Printing Museum
coordinates_source: osm:museum 扬州中国雕版印刷博物馆
note: Woodblock printing museum in the same building as Yangzhou Museum, showing traditional book printing.

name: Crane Mosque
note: Historic mosque (Xianhe Temple) in the Yangzhou old city, one of the city's Islamic heritage sites.

name: Canal Sanwan Scenic Area
note: Scenic belt along the Grand Canal in Yangzhou, named in travel listings as a frequent addition.

name: Pishi Street
note: Old street of shops and food in Yangzhou, named in travel listings.

name: Shaobo Lake
note: Lake in Jiangdu district beside Shaobo Ancient Town, with Ming-Qing stone wharves nearby.

name: Shaobo Ancient Town
note: Ancient town in Jiangdu with Ming-Qing stone wharves on the Grand Canal (Jiangdu Water Hub).

name: Jiangdu Water Hub
note: Water control hub that channels Yangtze water north into the Grand Canal at Jiangdu.

name: Longshan Mountain Scenic Resort
note: Hill-top scenic resort and forest park in Qingshan town, Yizheng, the main draw of the county-level city.

name: Zaolin Bay
note: Flower gardens and tea plantations in front of Mount Longshan in Yizheng.

name: Yangzijiang Park
note: Riverside park in Yizheng listed among local sights.

name: Gaoyou Lake
note: Third-largest lake in Jiangsu, spanning Gaoyou, Baoying and Jinhu near the Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal.

name: Yucheng Postal Stop
coordinates_source: osm:historic 运河·盂城驿历史文化街区
note: Early-Ming courier relay station on the Grand Canal, the most complete surviving postal stop of its kind, open to visitors.

name: Zhenguo Temple
note: Buddhist temple on a small island in the Grand Canal with a pagoda that dates to the Tang era.

name: Gaoyou Museum
note: Local museum in Gaoyou, free to enter, closed on Mondays.

name: Gaoyou–Shaobo Campaign Memorial Hall
note: Memorial hall in an old church recording the December 1945 Gaoyou–Shaobo campaign, free to enter.

name: Gaoyou Old Town
note: Old town of Gaoyou with antique shops, morning food markets and street life.

name: Wang Zengqi Memorial Hall
note: Memorial hall to the Gaoyou-born writer Wang Zengqi, named in travel listings.

name: Hu Guo Temple
note: Temple in Gaoyou named in travel listings; visitor detail is thin.

name: Qingshuitan Tourist Resort
note: Tourist resort in Gaoyou named in travel listings.

name: Longqiuzhuang Site
note: Neolithic archaeological site in Gaoyou named in travel listings; a site with little visitor infrastructure.

name: Baoying Lake National Wetland Park
note: National wetland park in Baoying with water cypress forests, lotus wetlands and lotus root farms along the Grand Canal.

name: Baoying Canal Scenic Belt
note: 40.5 km canal scenic belt in Baoying county, named in the Yangzhou government travel guide.

name: Wanghai Tower
note: Newly built tower in the Fengcheng River scenic area of Taizhou city, with views over the riverside.

name: Guangxiao Temple
note: Buddhist temple in Taizhou city, named in the Taizhou government list of historic sites.

name: Chongru Temple
note: Temple in Taizhou named in the Taizhou government list of historic and scenic places.

name: Chenghuang Temple
note: City-god temple in Taizhou named in the Taizhou government list of historic places.

name: Anding Academy
note: Historic academy in Taizhou named in the Taizhou government list of historic places.

name: Rishe Garden
note: Garden in Taizhou named in the Taizhou government list of historic and scenic places.

name: Fengcheng River Scenic Area
note: Riverside scenic area in Hailing district where Wanghai Tower stands.

name: Taizhou Old Street
note: Old Street (Lao Jie) in Taizhou; Wikivoyage notes it is a new development with restaurants and souvenir stalls.

name: Mei Lanfang Memorial Hall
note: Park and memorial museum to the Peking Opera master Mei Lanfang, born in Taizhou.

name: Hu Jintao Birthplace Neighbourhood
note: Old neighbourhood in Jiangyan where former leader Hu Jintao was born; the house is not marked and only the old streets are of interest.

name: Taizhou Museum
note: Municipal museum of Taizhou city.

name: PLA Navy Establishment Memorial Hall
coordinates_source: osm:museum 中国人民解放军海军诞生地纪念馆
note: Memorial museum at the birthplace of the People's Navy, where the navy was founded in Taizhou.

name: Taizhou Navy Vessel Cultural Park
coordinates_source: osm:museum 泰州海军舰艇文化园
note: Park with decommissioned navy vessels beside the PLA Navy birthplace memorial in Taizhou.

name: Taoyuan Scenic Area
note: Scenic area in Taizhou city named in OpenStreetMap as an attraction.

name: Qinhu Lake National Wetland Park
coordinates_source: osm:attraction 溱湖国家湿地公园野生动植物保护中心 (park visitor centre)
note: National wetland park in Jiangyan with reeds, dawn redwoods, lotus and poplars beside the lake.

name: Water Forest
note: Wetland park with a forest of water-tolerant trees in Xinghua.

name: Tiandehu Park
note: Park in Taizhou named among the city's natural scenery sites.

name: Qianduo Scenic Area
note: Canola (rapeseed) flower fields across canal islets north of Xinghua, a spring draw from late March to April.

name: Xique Lake
note: Lake in Jiangyan district named in the district's tourism section.

name: Qintong Ancient Town
coordinates_source: osm:attraction 溱潼古镇旅游景区
note: Ancient town in Jiangyan district, a 4A-rated attraction, with a Qintong boat festival held nearby.

name: Qintong Boat Festival
note: Annual boat festival at Qintong, an event rather than a permanent place.

name: Guluotang Cultural Block
coordinates_source: osm:viewpoint 姜堰古罗塘文化景区
note: Historic cultural block in the north of Jiangyan district, rated 4A.

name: Xiaoyang Village Cherry Blossom Avenue
note: Village in Jiangyan with a 420 m cherry blossom avenue, a spring draw.

name: Binhe Scenic Belt
note: Riverside scenic belt in Jiangyan district.

name: Huangqiao Ancient Town
note: Ancient town in Taixing with a 1940 battle site, a New Fourth Army memorial hall and the He family ancestral hall.

name: New Fourth Army Huangqiao Battle Memorial Hall
wiki: New Fourth Army Huangqiao Battle Memorial Hall
coordinates_source: osm:museum 新四军黄桥战役纪念馆
note: Memorial hall at the Huangqiao battle site in Taixing.

name: National Ancient Ginkgo Park
note: Park of rare ancient ginkgo trees in Taixing, best in late autumn when the leaves turn gold.

name: Jingjiang Bell Tower
note: Bell tower landmark in the centre of Jingjiang city.

name: Gushan Scenic Area
note: Hill and lake scenic area in Jingjiang with mountain views and tranquil lake water.

name: Longdu Scenic Area
note: Culture and leisure scenic area in the northwest of Jingjiang.

name: Jingjiang Ancient City Scenic Area
note: Scenic area in the centre of Jingjiang built around its old city.

name: Liu Guojun Former Residence
note: Former residence of the Jingjiang-born general Liu Guojun, a historic house.

name: Jingjiang People's Park
note: Public park in Jingjiang named in local attraction lists.

name: Mazhou Academy
note: Historic academy in Jingjiang named in local attraction lists.

name: Taizhou Wanda Plaza
note: Shopping and entertainment complex in Hailing district, a shopping centre rather than an attraction.

name: Pozi Street
note: Commercial pedestrian street in Hailing district, the traditional shopping and restaurant centre.

name: Qingyun Temple
note: Temple in Taizhou listed in Wikipedia's Taizhou tourist-attraction category.

name: Luyanghu Wetland Park with Sequoias
coordinates_source: osm:attraction 渌洋湖湿地公园北门
note: Wetland park with sequoias and a visitor entrance in the Yangzhou area, found in OpenStreetMap only.

name: Wenfeng Pagoda
note: Historic pagoda in Yangzhou found in OpenStreetMap only; no visitor source checked.

name: Sui Emperor Yang Mausoleum Museum
coordinates_source: osm:museum 隋炀帝陵遗址博物馆
note: Museum at the mausoleum site of Emperor Yang of Sui in Yangzhou, found in OpenStreetMap only.

name: Qionghua Temple
note: Taoist temple beside the Slender West Lake district named for the qionghua flower, found in OpenStreetMap only.

name: Zhu Ziqing Former Residence
note: Former residence of the writer Zhu Ziqing in Yangzhou, found in OpenStreetMap only.

name: Jiang Zemin Former Residence
note: Former residence of Jiang Zemin in Yangzhou, found in OpenStreetMap only.

name: Xichun Terrace
note: Terrace building in the Slender West Lake area, found in OpenStreetMap only.

name: Yangzhou Eight Eccentrics Memorial Hall
note: Memorial museum to the Yangzhou Eight Eccentrics painters, found in OpenStreetMap only.
